type GovernmentIDVerification struct {

    VerificationType string // "drivers_license", "passport", etc

Enforce age gate in assessment. Block users under 18. CRITICAL for dating app compliance.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Check DOB from government ID verification
- Calculate age at assessment time
- Block assessment if age < 18
- Return specific error code (UNDERAGE_USER)
- Log underage attempts with timestamp
- Alert admin to potential child protection issue
- Prevent account creation for users under 18

## Compliance Requirements
- COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act)
- Dating app industry standard (18+ only)
- Audit trail of all age gate denials
- Automatic reporting to admin dashboard

## Implementation Details
Files:
- internal/policy/age_gate.go (new)

## Age Calculation
- Use ID verification DOB as source of truth
- Calculate age as: today - DOB (in years)
- Timezone-aware calculation
- Account for leap years

## Blocking Behavior
- Return HTTP 403 Forbidden
- Error code: "UNDERAGE_USER"
- Error message: "You must be 18+ to use this service"
- No account creation allowed
- No further processing

## Alerting
- Alert type: "CHILD_PROTECTION_ISSUE"
- Alert to: admin@trustgraph.local
- Include: Subject ID, DOB, Timestamp, IP address
- Escalation: Manual review within 1 hour

## Audit Trail
- All age gate checks logged
- Passed and failed attempts logged
- Queryable for compliance reports
- Retention: 7 years (industry standard)

## Testing
- Unit tests: various DOBs
- Boundary test: exactly 18 years old
- Integration test: assessment flow
- Compliance test: audit trail generation

## Definition of Done
- Age gate enforces 18+ requirement
- Alerts working and tested
- Audit trail comprehensive
- Zero false positives
- Legal review passed
- Ready for launch
